notes: Official Hero Sushi Australia nutrition and product pages were checked on 2026-07-05. The official nutrition table publishes energy in kJ and vegetarian badges for many items, but generally does not publish protein grams.
Calories are converted from official kJ values using 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ and rounded to one decimal.

Only items with official product-page protein grams are proposed. Vegetarian suitability for these two rows is inferred from item names and ingredients, not from a visible VEG badge on the product page.
Trap: the nutrition table marks some obviously non-vegetarian names with a VEG badge, including Garlic Soy Chicken Roll, so badges were not used blindly.
Trap: related-product quick views embedded in product pages can contain macro tables for a different product. Values here come from the main product description, not related-product popups.
Trap: official menu/listing kJ values sometimes differ between kiosk/menu and train-menu contexts. Treat each source URL as a specific menu product, not a universal Hero Sushi item.
Agedasi Tofu may use dashi or shared fryer/prep processes depending on store practice; confirm suitability before importing as a strict vegetarian item.
Plain Udon is listed with ingredient 'Udon plain' and explicit macros, but it is not visibly VEG-badged in the official pages checked.

Official VEG-badged sides/extras such as Edamame, Seaweed Salad, Seaweed Inari, Plain Inari, Vege Gyoza, Spring Roll, Mix Vege Tempura, and Baby Avocado/Cucumber were omitted because no official product-page protein grams were found for the named product.
